senses.zh_definition: Arjun：男性人名，可音译为“阿尔俊”；此处仅记录已见的专名用法。
senses.en_definition: Arjun, a masculine personal name attested in Malaysian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang dieja Arjun dan digunakan sebagai nama individu.
senses.nuances: 本义为专名用法，不能据此将小写 arjun 标为已获 DBP 确认的普通词；因此状态保留为 unverified。人名用例见 [Sunway University](https://sunwayuniversity.edu.my/news/2024/how-lancaster-sunway-partnership-helped-phd-candidate-arjun)。下列组合是人名称呼示例，并非已证实的高频词汇搭配；马来语释义为编辑说明，不是 DBP 官方释义。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场通知 / 人名用法示例
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Arjun akan membentangkan laporan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 阿尔俊先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目情况。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Arjun will present the project report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事联系人名用法示例
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Arjun dah sampai kat pejabat ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Arjun sudah tiba di pejabat?
dual_scenarios.zh: Arjun 已经到办公室了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Has Arjun arrived at the office yet?
spoken_features: Arjun 是人名，在句中使用大写首字母。
dah 对应 sudah，kat 对应 di。
句末 ke 构成口语疑问，对应标准语的 adakah。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Arjun dah sampai kat pejabat ke? Aku nak jumpa dia kejap.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Arjun sudah tiba di pejabat? Saya mahu berjumpa dengannya sebentar.
messages.zh: Arjun 到办公室了吗？我想找他一下。
messages.en: Has Arjun arrived at the office yet? I need to see him briefly.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia kat bilik mesyuarat je. Nanti aku bagitahu dia, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan berada di bilik mesyuarat. Saya akan memberitahunya sebentar lagi.
messages.zh: 到了，他就在会议室。我一会儿跟他说一声。
messages.en: Yes, he's in the meeting room. I'll let him know in a moment.

etymology.historical_story: Arjun is attested as a personal name in Malaysian institutional publications. The similar form arjuna has a separate Malay dictionary entry with literary meanings involving a heroic or beloved man. Similar spelling alone does not establish that the packet intends this word, a name, or another usage. Its intended etymology therefore remains unresolved. Sources: [Sunway University](https://sunwayuniversity.edu.my/news/2024/how-lancaster-sunway-partnership-helped-phd-candidate-arjun), [PRPM: arjuna](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=176312&keyword=arjuna).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若语境指人，就把 Arjun 与姓名牌联系起来；先记住“这是名字”，不要凭相似拼写把它当成 arjuna 的普通词义。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式称呼成年男性时可按场合使用 Encik Arjun；实际称谓和读音应尊重本人偏好。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 保留本人使用的姓名拼写，不擅自补成 Arjuna，也不凭姓名推断宗教、国籍或族群。当前例句仅展示人名用法。
